Looping in a couple technical clarifications based on John's notes: 

1) H100 confirmation: H100s are preferred for lower-latency large-context workloads - we'll mark H100 as the target in the spec and include an alternate A100 config for procurement fallback.
2) Rack power: 18kW nominal is fine for our baseline config. We'll add a note in the spec for a 25kW option and the cooling considerations.
3) Image provisioning & transfer process (air-gap): proposed flow below - happy to walk through on the deep-dive:
   - Redwood engineers build signed, hashed images in our secure build environment.
   - Images are exported onto encrypted media at Redwood SOC facility and shipped via bonded courier to LegacyBank secure desk.
   - LegacyBank Ops will ingest media into the air-gapped environment and run a checksum validation.
   - On first install, Redwood engineer will be onsite for verification and to run smoke tests; subsequent updates follow the offline ops checklist.

I've added a few checklist items to offline-ops-checklist.xlsx (packaging/process/timestamping). Also creating a shared drive folder for the project and will drop a technical runbook draft there.

Two asks for the deep-dive call:
- Could LegacyBank infra share target maintenance windows and any blackout dates for Q1?
- Please confirm Procurement contact so we can share the alternate SKU pricing.

Thanks - Monica
